But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.
and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!
See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.

verses.text: the God who avenges me and brings down nations beneath me,

xrefs.text: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.
He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.

On hearing that Nabal was dead, David said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has upheld my cause against the reproach of Nabal and has restrained His servant from evil. For the LORD has brought the wickedness of Nabal down upon his own head.” Then David sent word to Abigail, asking her to become his wife.
For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.
A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”

verses.text: who frees me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.

He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap. He seats them among princes and bestows on them a throne of honor. For the foundations of the earth are the LORD’s, and upon them He has set the world.
I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come forth from Jacob, and a scepter will arise from Israel. He will crush the skulls of Moab and strike down all the sons of Sheth.
Water will flow from his buckets, and his seed will have abundant water. His king will be greater than Agag, and his kingdom will be exalted.

verses.text: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.

xrefs.text: so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy. As it is written: “Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles; I will sing hymns to Your name.”
Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.

verses.text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.”

xrefs.text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.
And when your days are fulfilled and you rest with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, who will come from your own body, and I will establish his kingdom.
I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
